name: Chives
description: Chives are perennial herbs in the onion family. Their thin, hollow leaves add a gentle onion flavour, and the purple flowers are edible too.
growing: Choose a sunny spot; partial shade is fine too. Keep the soil evenly moist but not waterlogged, and snip the leaves regularly, leaving a short base so they can regrow.
tip: Try chives with plain yogurt, a little lemon juice and black pepper for a quick herb dip.
